name: SolEnrich

overview.text: SolEnrich presents paid on-chain intelligence for Solana trading agents, advertising 52 endpoints for token risk, exit signals, perps-venue comparison and StonkFun workflows. It describes deterministic scoring with JSON or LLM briefings and pay-per-call USDC access on Solana or Base, without keys or subscriptions. Example prices include $0.004 token enrichment, $0.04 exit signals and $0.02 venue comparison. Examples, mainnet labels and settlement claims do not establish predictive performance or paid demand. Risk and wallet-link assessments can be wrong and do not prove investment suitability or common ownership.
